chat.title: Ganira na Rinda
chat.intro: Muraho, ndi Rinda. Mbaza ibibazo bigera kuri 5 ku munsi ku byavuye mu isuzuma ryawe n'imibereho ya buri munsi.
chat.introStaff: Muraho, ndi Rinda. Mbaza ibibazo bigera kuri 5 ku munsi kuri Rinda Health n'imico itandatu ya buri munsi isuzuma.
chat.placeholder: Baza ku byavuye mu isuzuma cyangwa ku mico yawe
chat.offTopic: Nshobora gufasha gusa ku bibazo bijyanye na Rinda Health, ibyavuye mu isuzuma ryawe n'imico ya buri munsi.
chat.unavailable: Sinshobora gusubiza ubu. Ongera ugerageze nyuma, cyangwa usubire ku rupapuro rwawe.
chat.personal: Nyamuneka ntushyiremo nimero za telefoni, nimero z'indangamuntu cyangwa aderesi za imeyili.
chat.limit: Wabajije ibibazo 5 byawe by'uyu munsi. Ongera ugaruke ejo.
chat.off: Ikiganiro ntigifunguye kuri konti yawe. Ushobora gufungura ibisobanuro bya AI muri porofayili yawe.
chat.english: Ikiganiro gisubiza mu Cyongereza gusa ubu.
